feeds.title: Pillar Box Blue
feeds.description: Pillar box blue is all about craft and upcycling. Follow me as I craft and revamp the things around me. The site is full of tutorials to help and inspire you to create. My name is Claire and many of my projects on Pillar Box Blue have some sort of personal connection to me, whether it is in the materials used or inspiration from friends and family.

feeds.title: Vicky Myers creations
feeds.description: I enjoy sewing, especially with preloved fabric. A love of recycling and caring for the environment is the perfect excuse to haunt charity shops for bargains! Follow my creative journey, sewing, upcycling and experimenting.

feeds.title: Upcycle My Stuff
feeds.description: Upcycle My Stuff is a DIY blog with Upcycling Inspiration, Tutorials & Support for Upcycling Businesses. I'm Kristen, I run Upcycle My Stuff. I have a passion for reusing, repurposing and adding value to things that might otherwise end up being thrown away - which is what upcycling is all about.

feeds.title: Creative Upcycling & Mixed Media
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with articles on upcyling and recycling, mixed media, Gelli plate printing, collage, and more.

feeds.title: Upcycle Arcade Blog
feeds.description: Upcycle Arcade turns old into 'new' by restoring & upcycling furniture. A custom upcycling service plus workshops for all ages promotes sustainable living. At Upcycle Arcade, we Upcycle, Recycle, Craft and Create to promote longevity, and sustainability as Old is definitely the new New.

feeds.title: Frenchic Paint Blog » Upcycling
feeds.description: Find inspiration for your next upcycling project. From staircases to garden furniture, we've got plenty of unique ideas to spark your upcycling flame. Frenchic Paint is the UK's fastest growing Chalk Paint Company with over 150 creamy colours in 6 different ranges.

feeds.title: KezzabethCreates » Upcycling
feeds.description: Welcome to my UK DIY Home Renovation & Interiors Blog. Here you can find DIY projects to upcycle household items and change the look of your home! I'm Kezzabeth, a self-taught DIYer, Renovator and Blogger on a mission to turn our house into a home.

feeds.title: Re_considered Blog
feeds.description: The Re_considered Journal brings you sustainable and beautiful fashion advice and how you can make better choices with the clothes you wear. Re_considered believes in repairing, rewearing, restyling, and rethinking the way we approach consumption.

feeds.title: Colour Me KT Blog
feeds.description: Colour Me KT provides Furniture Upcycling Blogs and Tips. I'm Kate Holt, the founder of Colour Me KT. I started painting and upholstering furniture over 20 years ago when I was redoing my daughter's bedroom and couldn't find furniture that I liked. I have turned my hobby/ lifestyle into a small but growing business, specialising in painting and upholstering custom one off furniture pieces.

feeds.title: The Shurgard Blog » Upcycling
feeds.description: Shurgard stores are staffed with customer-focused professionals dedicated to providing superior customer service. Follow us to keep up with articles on Upcyclinling.
